title: ReportManager with data()/empty() diverges from the repo's *Service naming with verb-first methods and predicate booleans
description: Both existing services (InvoiceService, ExportService) use the Service suffix, verb-first method names (fetchInvoices, exportCsv) and predicate-shaped booleans (isOverdue, hasRows). The new class is ReportManager with a noun-only data() and a bare empty(). Rename to ReportService, fetchReport, isEmpty.

title: validateReport asserts validation the code does not perform — it only returns the title
description: validateReport(report) performs no validation: it returns report.title. A caller reading the name assumes the report was checked. Rename to what it does (reportTitle) or drop it.
